data.name: Machina Blue
data.detailed_description:
Decades ago, Earth made first contact with strange alien creatures, and was plunged into chaos. You, a young farmer’s boy, live on a small island in the middle of it all. Frequent alien attacks, a mysterious corporation, and an upcoming private militia shape your world.

You work for Delta Corp, a secretive organisation dedicated to defending the island and studying the aliens. Meanwhile, most of humanity funds Militia One, a private mechanized militia with a single goal: to eradicate every alien on Earth. What the people need now is hope... And you are the last beacon of hope!

Meet the island’s unique inhabitants, uncover your past, and unravel the mysteries of Delta Corp. Your decisions shape your social connections and gameplay.

A beautiful island is suddenly attacked by strange alien creatures! It's your chance to prove yourself as a mech pilot and defend the island and it's people.

Machina Blue blends RPG and shooter elements together to deliver the soul of retro anime in a new, interactive way.



Features & Highlights

• Explore a Beautiful Island

Discover a small, homely island where the people are eager to meet you. Roam freely across four varied and lively locations, socialise with the inhabitants, and even date them.

• Hand-Painted, Old-School Anime Visuals

Experience an island of hand-crafted, stylised visuals; whether from a person’s perspective or high above in your own Machina. Every corner is filled with assets that honour the classic anime aesthetic.

• Third-Person Mech Gameplay

Immerse yourself in intense, high-stakes mech combat! Fight off a variety of enemies with a full arsenal of guns.

• Rich, Meaningful Relationships

Over the course of your one-year journey, you’ll meet people with different interests and goals. Your choices will determine the bonds you form.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (e.g., Intel Core 2 Duo, AMD Athlon X2)
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GT 630, AMD Radeon HD 7450)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or Apple M1 (integrated)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or equivalent (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (x86_64)
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 (Mesa drivers) or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
